responsibility: Declares the tree-specific diagnostic support layer used by GCC compilers proper. It provides macros for tracking the current and last diagnostic function context, prototypes for function-context reporting, macro-expansion unwinding, tree diagnostic defaults, the default tree format decoder, and path/JSON diagnostic hooks that integrate tree IR knowledge into the generic diagnostic framework.
same_name_distinction: Declares macros and function interfaces for tree-aware diagnostics, including context tracking and hook prototypes, while tree-diagnostic.cc provides the actual reporting, formatting, and unwinding implementations.
